purpose: Install one complete data-plane authorization generation on a connected plugin replica before Gateway activates a matching Caddy dispatch snapshot.

request.settingsDigest: must-equal-the-connected-replica-local-active-settings-digest; compare the opaque value exactly without normalization
request.releaseDigest: must-equal-the-connected-replica-local-running-release-digest; compare the opaque value exactly without normalization

capabilities.meaning: complete capability-to-invocation-mode authorization set for this generation; not a patch
capabilities.entries: capability names are non-empty and unique; each entry has at least one unique, non-unspecified InvocationMode declared by this replica's Manifest

request.failure: reject without partially changing the active generation or its authorization scope

acknowledgement.dispatchDigest: non-empty opaque digest identifying the complete installed capability-to-mode scope; its encoding and canonicalization are implementation-defined in v1 and must not be used as a cross-implementation equality key

reconnect: a newly established control connection repeats TLS identity validation and handshake; Gateway reapplies the currently desired generation before the replica becomes Ready

authorization.dataPlane: Caddy-data identity may call only Call and Stream, authorized against the acknowledged active generation
